a.xlink:title: Reads a register.

Brings up the device and arms wake-up card detection.

Diagnostic: triggers one manual wake-up measurement and reads the raw ADC result.

Polls "IRQ_STATUS_3" to check wake-up detection state.
Diagnostic: reads raw Display 1/2 registers.
Reads the "IC_IDENTITY" register as a basic chip-presence/identity sanity check.
Reads a message from the FIFO, polling the status register up to "timeout".
Reads a register into an output parameter.
Reads the transmit/receive pipeline diagnostic snapshot ("TxRxDiagnostics").
Reads wake-up pipeline diagnostics (raw ADC/reference/calibration values, both channels).
